title: Requires overload signatures to be adjacent
summary: Forces TypeScript overload signatures to be declared adjacent to each other for readability and maintenance.

title: Ban ts-comment
summary: Disallows `// @ts-*` TypeScript directives unless they include an explicit trailing comment explaining why.

title: Ban types
summary: Bans primitive wrapper object types like `String`/`Number`, plus `Function` and the misunderstood `Object` type.

title: Ban unknown rule code
summary: Warns when `deno-lint-ignore` uses unknown rule names that Deno lints don’t provide.

title: Ban untagged ignore
summary: Requires `deno-lint-ignore` to specify one or more rule names instead of ignoring all lint rules.

title: Ban untagged todo
summary: Requires TODO comments to include a user tag `@user` or issue reference `#issue`, not just free text.

title: Ban unused ignore
summary: Flags unused `deno-lint-ignore` directives that no longer suppress any lint errors (e.g., after refactors).

title: Camelcase
summary: Enforces camelCase for variable names and object property identifiers, with rules for leading/trailing `_` and quoting snake_case.

title: Constructor super
summary: Ensures derived class constructors call `super()` and that classes extending non-constructors don’t declare constructors.

title: Default param last
summary: Requires default parameters to appear last in a function signature to avoid confusing argument mapping.

title: Eqeqeq
summary: Enforces `===`/`!==` over `==`/`!=` to prevent type-coercion equality surprises.

title: Explicit function return type
summary: Requires explicit return types on all functions, flagging functions without typed signatures.

title: Explicit module boundary types
summary: Requires exported functions and constants to have fully typed parameters and return types for module boundaries.

title: For loop direction
summary: Enforces `for` loop control variables to increment in the correct direction to avoid infinite loops.

title: Fresh handler export
summary: Fresh route middleware must be exported as named `handler`, not `handlers`.

title: Fresh server event handlers
summary: Disallows event handler props in fresh server components under the `routes/` folder.

title: Getter return
summary: Requires all JavaScript/TypeScript property getter functions to return a value.

title: Guard for-in
summary: Requires `for-in` loops to include an `if` using `Object.hasOwn` to filter prototype properties.

title: JSX boolean value
summary: Enforces that JSX boolean props omit `={true}` via shorthand, but keep `={false}` explicitly.

title: JSX button has type
summary: Requires `<button>` elements to have a `type` attribute to avoid default submit behavior in forms.

title: JSX curly braces
summary: Enforces consistent curly braces around JSX expressions, e.g. `foo={<div />}` not `foo=<div />`.

title: JSX key
summary: Requires a `key` attribute on JSX elements when rendering arrays/iterables to aid reconciliation.

title: JSX no children prop
summary: Disallows passing React/Fresh `children` via the `children` prop; must use JSX children instead.

title: JSX no comment text nodes
summary: Prevents plain-text JSX output by disallowing JS comments directly inside JSX text nodes.

title: JSX no duplicate props
summary: Disallows duplicated JSX props where later props overwrite earlier ones.

title: JSX no unescaped entities
summary: Disallows unescaped `>` and `}` in JSX, requiring them as strings (e.g. `>` or `{'>'}`).

title: JSX no useless fragment
summary: Disallows unnecessary JSX fragments except at top-level block with multiple children.

title: Disallow multiple identical JSX prop spreads
summary: Flags JSX props where the same spread expression is used multiple times on an element.

title: No children for JSX void DOM elements
summary:
Disallows children inside HTML void elements like
and in JSX/TSX.

title: No Array constructor
summary: Disallows new Array() usage except for new Array(fixedLength); prefers array literals like [] or [1,2,3].

title: No async Promise executor functions
summary: Requires promise executors passed to new Promise(...) not to be async.

title: No await in loop
summary: Disallows await inside for-loop bodies to prevent sequential blocking; suggests awaiting collected promises instead.

title: No await in non-async function
summary: Disallows using await inside non-async functions; requires marking the function async.

title: No boolean literals for arguments
summary: Requires replacing boolean literal arguments (e.g., true/false) with named constants for clarity.

title: No unscoped declarations in switch cases
summary: Requires wrapping lexical declarations in switch case/default blocks with braces to scope them correctly.

title: No class assignment
summary: Disallows reassigning the variable created by a class declaration (e.g., ClassName = 0).

title: No comparison against negative zero
summary: Disallows comparisons against -0; use Object.is(x, -0) instead.

title: No assignment in conditional statements
summary: Disallows assignment operator (=) inside conditionals unless wrapped in parentheses to indicate intent.

title: No console usage
summary: Disallows use of the console global (console.log/error/debug), recommending deno-lint-ignore for explicit enablement.

title: No reassignment of const variables
summary: Disallows modifying variables declared with const (e.g., a = 1, a++).

title: No constant conditions
summary: Disallows constant expressions in conditional tests like if(true) and if(2), including infinite-loop do/while.

title: No control characters in regex
summary: Disallows ASCII control characters (0-31) inside regular expression patterns.

title: Disallow `debugger` statements
summary: Flags use of the JavaScript `debugger` statement so execution won’t pause in production.

title: Disallow deleting variables
summary: Prevents deleting variables declared with `var`, `let`, or `const`; object properties via `delete obj.prop` are allowed.

title: Warn on deprecated Deno APIs
summary: Warns when using deprecated Deno APIs in the `Deno.*` namespace, listing specific items to migrate off.

title: Disallow duplicate function arguments
summary: Disallows duplicate parameter names in a function signature to avoid shadowing caused by repeated args.

title: Disallow duplicate class member names
summary: Rejects duplicate method names in a class body to prevent overwritten class member declarations.

title: Disallow duplicate `else if` conditions
summary: Flags repeating the same condition in an `if`/`else if` chain where the later branch will never run.

title: Disallow duplicate object literal keys
summary: Disallows duplicate keys in object literals where later assignments override earlier ones.

title: Disallow duplicate `switch` cases
summary: Disallows duplicate `case` clauses in a `switch` statement so earlier cases aren’t unreachable.

title: Disallow empty regex character classes
summary: Prevents regex character classes like `[]` in patterns because they match nothing and are likely a mistake.

title: Disallow empty enums
summary: Flags enum declarations with no members (e.g., `enum Foo {}`) as unnecessary or mistaken implementations.

title: Disallow empty interfaces
summary: Rejects empty TypeScript interfaces (e.g., `interface Foo {}`) except for certain extension/identity use cases.

title: Disallow empty destructuring patterns
summary: Disallows empty destructuring patterns like `{}` or `[]` that have no effect.

title: Disallow empty blocks
summary: Flags empty block statements such as empty `if`, loops, `switch`, or `try/catch/finally` bodies.

title: Disallow `eval`
summary: Disallows use of the `eval` function due to security vulnerabilities and performance concerns.

title: Disallow reassigning exception parameters
summary: Prevents reassignment of caught exception parameters (e.g., `catch (e) { e = ... }`).

title: Disallow `any` type
summary: Flags use of TypeScript’s `any` type; suggests `unknown` or specific types instead.

title: Disallow external URL imports
summary: Warns when modules are imported via URL strings; suggests using `deps.ts` convention or import maps.

title: Disallow unnecessary boolean casts
summary: Disallows unnecessary boolean casts like `!!foo` and `Boolean(foo)` in `if/while/for` conditions.

title: Disallow unnecessary non-null assertions
summary: Flags redundant non-null assertions such as `foo!!` and `bar!?.str`; requires single `!` or `?.` usage.

title: Disallow implicit fallthrough
summary: Enforces `break` or an explicit `fallthrough` comment in `switch` case fallthroughs.

title: Disallow function reassignment
summary: Prevents overwriting an existing function by reassignment (e.g., `foo = bar` or reassigning function identifiers).

title: Disallow assignment to native objects
summary: Disallows assignment to native globals like `Object`, `undefined`, or `window`.

title: Disallow implicit ambient namespace exports
summary: Disallows implicit exports of members in ambient (`declare namespace`) namespaces without explicit named exports.

title: Disallow deprecated import assertions
summary: Flags deprecated `assert` syntax for import attributes; requires `with { ... }` instead.

title: Disallow reassignment of import bindings
summary: Disallows reassigning imported module bindings (including replacing namespace imports with `{}`) but allows property mutation.

title: Enforce import declarations via deno.json/package.json
summary: Requires external module specifiers be declared in `deno.json` or `package.json` imports (no direct `https://`/`npm:`/`jsr:`).

title: Disallow easily inferrable types
summary: Flags easily inferrable primitive/null literal types like `const x: number = 10`.

title: Disallow inner declarations
summary: Disallows variable and function declarations inside nested blocks, but allows function expressions and named/anonymous functions.

title: Disallow invalid RegExp constructor patterns
summary: Rejects invalid regular expression literals in `RegExp` constructors (e.g., `new RegExp(")")`).

title: Warn on invalid triple-slash references
summary: Warns about wrong triple-slash reference directives in Deno; only `types` is allowed in JavaScript files.

title: no-irregular-whitespace
summary: Disallows non-space/non-tab Unicode whitespace like NBSP, BOM, line tabulation, and form feed in code.

title: no-misused-new
summary: Flags using `constructor` on interfaces or `new` methods on classes, and gives valid/invalid TypeScript examples.

title: no-namespace
summary: Disallows `namespace`/`module` keywords except for ambient namespaces with `declare` and inside `.d.ts` files.

title: no-new-symbol
summary: Disallows `new Symbol(...)` and requires calling `Symbol(...)` as a function except for non-builtin symbols.

title: no-node-globals
summary: Disallows NodeJS global objects like `Buffer`; use `import { Buffer } from "node:buffer"` to satisfy the rule.

title: no-non-null-asserted-optional-chain
summary: Disallows `!` non-null assertions after an optional chain (`?.`), e.g. `foo?.bar!`.

title: no-non-null-assertion
summary: Disallows TypeScript `!` non-null assertion postfix operator and suggests using `?.` and `??` instead.

title: no-obj-calls
summary: Prevents calling built-in globals like `Math()`, `JSON()`, `Reflect()`, and `Atomics()` as functions.

title: no-octal
summary: Disallows legacy octal numeric literals starting with `0` (e.g. `042`), encourages `0o` prefix instead.

title: no-process-global
summary: Disallows using NodeJS `process` global directly; import it via `import process from "node:process"`.

title: no-prototype-builtins
summary: Disallows calling `hasOwnProperty`, `isPrototypeOf`, and `propertyIsEnumerable` directly on objects.

title: no-redeclare
summary: Disallows redeclaring variables/functions/parameters with the same name using `var`, `let`, `const`, or duplicates.

title: no-regex-spaces
summary: Disallows multiple spaces inside regex literals (e.g. `/foo  bar/`), encourages `{n}` repetition syntax.

title: no-self-assign
summary: Disallows self-assignments like `a = a;` and destructuring self-assigns that make no effect.

title: no-self-compare
summary: Disallows comparisons where both sides are the same expression/value, like `x === x` or `a.b === a.b`.

title: Disallow returning values from setters
summary: Flags returning a value from setters; returning without a value is allowed for early returns.

title: Disallow shadowing restricted names
summary: Disallows shadowing restricted global/identifier names: NaN, Infinity, undefined, eval, and arguments.

title: Enforce explicit module specifier paths
summary: Requires explicit file extensions in module specifiers when --unstable-sloppy-imports is enabled.

title: Enforce explicit or inferrable types
summary: Enforces using types that are explicit or can be inferred simply; links to jsr about slow types.

title: Disallow sparse arrays
summary: Disallows sparse arrays with empty slots (e.g., ["foo", , "bar"]) to avoid undefined/skipped behavior.

title: Disallow sync functions inside async functions
summary: Prevents using sync blocking calls like Deno.readTextFileSync inside async functions.

title: Disallow assigning variables to this
summary: Disallows assigning `this` to a variable; recommends arrow functions to preserve `this` correctly.

title: Disallow this/super before super()
summary: Disallows accessing `this` or `super` before calling super() in derived class constructors.

title: Disallow throwing literals as exceptions
summary: Disallows throwing non-Error literals like string/number/null/undefined; requires throwing Error objects.

title: Disallow top-level await
summary: Disallows top-level await expressions because they break CommonJS/UMD distribution via dnt.

title: Disallow use of undeclared variables
summary: Flags use of undeclared variables, e.g., referencing someFunction or undefined identifiers.

title: Disallow unreachable code
summary: Disallows unreachable code after control flow statements like return/throw/break/continue.

title: Disallow control flow in finally blocks
summary: Disallows return/throw/break/continue inside finally blocks since they override try/catch control flow.

title: Disallow unsafe negation usage
summary: Warns when `!` is used as the left operand of relational operators like in/instanceof.

title: Disallow unused labels
summary: Disallows labels that are declared but never used; suggests removing or using the label.

title: No Unused Vars
summary: Flags declared variables that are never read, called/constructed, or exported; suggests prefixing intentional unused vars with _.

title: No Unversioned Import
summary: Requires inline import specifiers like npm:chalk@5.3.0 or jsr:@std/path@^1.0.8; disallows unversioned ones.

title: No Useless Rename
summary: Disallows rename operations where the original and new identifier names are identical (e.g., foo as foo).

title: No Var
summary: Rejects function-scoped var declarations and recommends block-scoped let/const instead.

title: No Window Prefix
summary: Disallows using Web APIs via the window prefix (e.g., window.fetch), with specific allowed exceptions like window.alert.

title: No Window
summary: Rejects use of the window global (not available in Deno) and recommends fetch via globalThis/self.

title: No With
summary: Disallows JavaScript with statements due to confusing bugs and compatibility issues.

title: Prefer As Const
summary: Recommends const assertions (as const) over literal type annotations and other type assertions for primitives.

title: Prefer ASCII
summary: Enforces that all code characters are ASCII to enable V8 one-byte string optimizations.

title: Prefer Const
summary: Recommends using const instead of let when a variable could be non-mutable after initialization.

title: Prefer Namespace Keyword
summary: Prefers TypeScript namespace keyword over module for TypeScript-specific module organization.

title: Prefer Primordials
summary: Suggests replacing direct global intrinsic usage with frozen primordials.* intrinsics to avoid prototype pollution.

title: React No Danger With Children
summary: Forbids JSX children on elements using dangerouslySetInnerHTML because the children will be ignored.

title: React No Danger
summary: Prevents use of dangerouslySetInnerHTML in JSX, which can cause XSS if misused.

title: React Rules of Hooks
summary: Enforces React/Preact Hooks are called only at top level of components, not in conditionals or loops.

title: Disallow async functions without await (require-await)
summary: Flags async functions or methods that contain no await expression/declaration, listing invalid async examples.

title: Disallow generator functions without yield (require-yield)
summary: Disallows generator functions (function*) that have no `yield` keyword; allows empty generator bodies.

title: Disallow multiple declarators in one statement (single-var-declarator)
summary: Disallows multiple variable definitions in a single const/let statement like `const a=1, b=2`.

title: Disallow triple-slash reference directives (triple-slash-reference)
summary: Reports triple-slash type directives (`reference path/types/lib`) and prefers ES6 import declarations instead.

title: Disallow comparisons to NaN (use-isnan)
summary: Requires `isNaN()` or `Number.isNaN()` instead of comparisons to `NaN` with ==, !=, ===, !==.

title: Restrict typeof comparisons to valid string literals (valid-typeof)
summary: Restricts `typeof` comparisons to allowed string literals (undefined/object/boolean/number/string/function/symbol/bigint).

title: Enforce type imports with verbatimModuleSyntax (verbatim-module-syntax)
summary: Enforces that type-only imports use `import type` (and `type` specifier) for compatibility with `verbatimModuleSyntax`.
